recognition: Validate pinned pg_dumpall provenance, raw hash, password boundary, known dump framing, declared encoding and no NUL.

Scan bytes with lexical states separating SQL, comments, string literals, dollar quotes, quoted identifiers and psql metacommand lines. Semicolons inside these contexts are not boundaries; nested block comments and doubled quote escapes must be handled.
A match must be a complete top-level CREATE ROLE <single identifier>; command with no WITH/options/trailing SQL. Keywords and identifier must be tokenized, not substring searched.

Unquoted identifiers use PostgreSQL lowercase rules for the explicitly supported ASCII profile. Double-quoted identifiers decode doubled double quotes and compare exact logical name; quoted semicolons/spaces never delimit a command.

Only decode the identifier token under verified dump encoding; preserve raw body bytes. Initial experiment supports ASCII bytes of the saved SQL_ASCII dump and clearly bounded quoted ASCII fixtures. Unknown multibyte/U& escapes/unsupported encoding or ambiguous scanner states fail closed; widening coverage requires a separate tested profile.

psql commands remain byte-identical. For the initial pinned profile recognize only the saved restrict/unrestrict framing; reject unexpected include/quit/conditional or command-buffer manipulation rather than pretending to parse them.

Count all bootstrap CREATE matches before deriving anything; require exactly one, source proof and destination same-name oid10, exact transport separation, and no source collision with the transport role.
derivationDesign.semanticGate: Require exact roles/memberships using same source oracle after only the one permitted transport role-row exclusion; require persistent ADMIN support and zero transport role/member/grantor footprint. rc0 alone is insufficient.
derivationDesign.splice: E = R[:start] + R[end:] where [start,end) is only the CREATE-through-semicolon span. Preserve the original following newline and every other byte; no whole-file decode/re-encode, newline conversion or statement reordering.
derivationDesign.stdinBinding: Before subprocess start assert actual stdin bytes == independently verified E; record stdin SHA equal executionInputSha256. Capture transport proof continues to bind R, never substitute E into outputSha256.
